name: Message
description: A note someone sends through the contact form. The handler writes the row first and sends the email second, so a mail-provider failure can never lose a message. Production starts empty: nobody has written yet, and that is the correct day-one state.

name: Post
description: One essay, mirrored from the Substack at blog.nseldeib.com. Authored there, never here — this table is a cache, not a CMS, which is why every row carries the canonical URL it came from. It exists because Substack's RSS only ever returns the 20 most recent posts: the feed is the source of new essays, and this is the memory of old ones, so a post that falls out of the feed window stays on the site instead of vanishing. bodyHtml is stored already sanitized, with Substack's subscribe forms and image-expand controls stripped out. Production starts empty and fills on the first request that reaches the feed.
